notes.title: Metal Drift Updated
notes.content:
FEATURES:

- Brand new level with a new look - Javelin.

- Major overhaul of the weapon reticles. Each one updated to emphasize useful information.

- Added Temporal and Shock reticles, as well as a new power up animation.

- Demo players and retail players can now compete in the same servers.

- Added support for private, password protected servers.

- New animated team crests, new cleaner team logos on stand banners.

- New map display.

- Added detail to the floor.

- New announcer audio.

- Larger projectiles for the Temporal Cannon.

- Added Boost pop-up indicator and chassis orientation display.

- New animated crowds.



FIXES:

- Flattened the leveling curve - 2x less grindy.

- Fixed issue where tank could jump long distances when in reverse.

- Fixed case where ball would drop and could not be picked up again.

- Shock cannon knockback set to be proportional to the amount of power stored.

- Reduced damage on the Plasma Launcher and Temporal Cannon weapons.

notes.title: Metal Drift Update Released
notes.content:
Features:
  • New scores HUD display at top of screen.
  • Added match rank indicator to HUD display.
  • Added kill streak indicator to HUD display.
  • New cool looking ball with LED animations.
  • Added cockpit glass reflection.
  • New "Meat Hunter" and "Road Trip Rampage" achievements.
  • Now displays icon over top 8 players indicating their match rank.
Fixes:

  • Changed chat colors to match new HUD.
  • Removed struts from cockpit for more visibility.
  • New HUD ball icon - can see ball much easier now.
  • Added lighting and detail to 1st person tank and cockpit.
  • Reduced end score and endgame pause times.
  • Fixed some login issues.
  • Changed team shuffle algorithm.
  • Fixed count up bar on weapons when they are max level.

notes.title: Tournament News - Teams
notes.content:
In light of the upcoming Metal Drift tournament (rules and info coming soon), I believe it's time to start putting some teams together. So open up that friends list of yours and figure out who you want to be on your team.

The only rule on choosing teams is that a team cannot have more than 4 members.

Besides that, you have total freedom. Talk it over with some friends. If none of your friends want to be on your team (Nice friends, eh?), then post on the tournament thread in the Steam forums and denote yourself as a "Loner" and you'll be placed on a team if any have an open slot.

Feel free to choose a team name. You may also want to chat with your teammates somehow and discuss strategies, positions, or who will be using what weapon/upgrade combo.

Remember, only 4 to a team. More info to come on the tournament.

Team rosters are required to be posted on the tournament thread in two weeks, Friday June 11.

TOURNAMENT THREAD: http://forums.steampowered.com/forums/showthread.php?p=15175677#post15175677

notes.title: Miner Wars - An Upcoming MMOFPS
notes.content: While chatting on the Metal Drift IRC (which you should totally check out!), I was linked to an upcoming game entitled Miner Wars. It's similar to EVE Online, where the gameplay takes place in space, but if differs in the fact that Miner Wars also adds in the FPS perspective. You may be wondering why I'm posting this. Well, Miner Wars is being made by an indie company called Keen Software House. After testing Metal Drift and seeing its release onto Steam, I know how hard it is for indie companies to get their game known and develop and decent playerbase (which, sadly, Metal Drift has not yet obtained). So, by posting this, I'm hoping to get Miner Wars some recognition before it goes into beta. I sincerely hope that you will follow the link to the Miner Wars site and check out what looks to be an epic game made by a fantastic group of indie devs. Miner Wars Site: http://www.minerwars.com/?aid=434
